exposure: Gestational age at diagnosis (early-term, full-term, late-term)
isolated oligohydramnios in the early-term period
isolated oligohydramnios in the full-term period
isolated oligohydramnios in the late-term period
cohort: 1213 term pregnancies complicated by isolated oligohydramnios
finding: While cesarean rate and newborn jaundice were higher in early-term oligohydramnios, timing of delivery did not significantly affect other neonatal outcomes like TTN, low Apgar score, ventilator requirement, or the composite outcome.
mod_finding: Cesarean rate was higher in early-term cases of isolated oligohydramnios compared to full-term cases.
